ITA-1.9.4.4.7 pṛthaktvam पृथक्त्वम्
Separation or exclusion, particularity
The quality by which one substance is differentiated or separated from the other.

pṛthukaḥ पृथुकः
Flattened rice
A preparation made from de-husked paddy which is moistened, fried, and then parched and flattened.

ITA-1.9.3.1.7 pṛthvī पृथ्वी
Earth element
Responsible for mass and the force of attraction. It acts as the substratum of smell, perceived by the nose.
